title: Findings list, contract v1
description: What a plugin in this repository writes as findings.json and what any plugin reading findings accepts. A list of findings, one object per finding. Canonical copy: shared/finding-contract/ at the repository root. Every plugin carries an identical copy beside finding_contract.py; scripts/sync-shared.py keeps them in step. Adding an optional field is a v1 change; removing a field, making one required or narrowing a type is v2.

id.description: Pass prefix and a number, unique within the list: COR-1, CMP-2, CPL-3, CNS-4, MIG-1, ADHOC-1.

pass.description: Which reviewer produced it, lower-case: completeness, correctness, compliance, consistency, migrations, adhoc. Open-ended so a new plugin can add a pass without a contract change.

path.description: Repository-relative path. Not absolute, and no '..' segment.

line.description: Line in the head version, or in the base version when side is LEFT.

end_line.description: Last line of a multi-line range, inclusive. Not less than line.

side.description: LEFT for a finding about deleted code, in which case line is a base-version line. Omitted means RIGHT.

body.description: Why it matters, plus the key evidence.

fix.description: A concrete, minimal suggestion in words.

suggestion.description: Literal replacement text for exactly the anchored lines, for a GitHub suggestion block.
